w: Swamishri arrived in Birmingham at 12.15 pm. While on the way to his residence, someone said, "It is the wish of Dr. Swami that you be awarded with the Nobel Peace Prize. The award-giving ceremony takes place in Stockholm, Sweden. This award should be given to you in the presence of all senior sadhus, saints and thousands of devotees." At this Swamishri immediately responded. "For us the biggest prize is having met Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. Everything is included in them. They are the topmost of the top. So whether one gets it or not, there is no attention of thought of it. That Maharaj and Swami are happy and Shastrij Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj have blessed us is the greatest of all prizes."

Yuvak - Yuvati National Convention Swamishri entered the morning assembly on the third day of the convention in a special way. The entire sabha was set up as if Swamishri was going on a padhramani to a devotee's home. As Swamishri entered, sadhus sang the traditional kirtan that is sung when sadhus go on a padhramani, “Ãj mãre orde re…” Following this, arti and thal were offered.

Then the devotees asked Swamishri questions about how to lead a good life. Swamishri spoke about this at great length, explaining that living an ideal life leads to a better family, which ultimately leads to a better society. After three days of gaining insight into Swamishri's continuous vicharan for the benefit of others, all yuvak and yuvati delegates were inspired to improve their personal lives and society overall. The theme of the day was ‘Our Journey,’ a quest now for yuvaks and yuvatis to do something for Swamishri. Throughout the day, sadhus described incidents of yuvaks who had sacrificed monetarily, physically and mentally for Swamishri.

During his blessings to the evening assembly, Swamishri talked about the glory of his gurus’ efforts. Despite his ceaseless travels around the world for the good of others, he emphasised that his vicharan is nothing compared to the vicharan of his gurus.

In the morning, while Swamishri performed his morning puja, devotees participated in a special mahapuja ceremony praying for the early completion of the mandir in Jamnagar. Afterwards, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha and arti rituals of the new marble murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and the murtis of the Guru Parampara.

A devotee from Africa came with his son and nephew to meet Swamishri. The devotee’s son was going to America for further studies, while his nephew was going to London. Swamishri blessed them and advised, “After going there you will be staying with other youths. So be extra careful that you do not pick up any addictions. There, others may be habitutated to drinking alcohol or other addictions but do not be affected by their company. Remain as firm as you are now.”
The nephew told Swamishri, “I will be staying with a friend there.”

Hearing this, Swamishri said, “If in his house, others eat (meat), drink (alcohol) or go partying, still then you should not join them. If you remain firm in this, God will be with you and you will progress in your studies.”
Sunday, 3 July 2005 (Jeth vad 12, Samvat 2061), Jamnagar

After 200 meetings following his meal, Pramukh Swami Maharaj came into his room. The well known orthopaedic surgeon Dr V. M. Shah had come for Swamishri's darshan. Talking with Swamishri, he said, "Even at this age the radiance of your face is just the same. And your eyes are amazing!"
Swamishri said, "Everything happens by God's will. Work happens according to His resolve. Whatever good happens, it all happens by God's grace."
"Good things do happen, but there must be some strength behind it!"
"That is God's strength and the guru's grace." Swamishri naturally placed all the credit at the feet of Maharaj and the guru.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals for a harimandir in the suburb of Mahesana.

At 9.20 am Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of the abhishek murti of Bhagwan Swaminarayan in the abhishek mandap below the mandir. The preliminary pratishtha rituals were performed by Ishwarcharan Swami, Viveksagar Swami and Satsangijivan Swami. Thereafter Swamishri performed the invocation and pujan, rituals and placed a garland around the murti. Then thal was offered and finally Swamishri performed the pratishtha arti. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the devotees, “Previously this place here was dark and ordinary. Then a decision was made to install an abhishek murti of Maharaj. “God only resides within when we rid ourselves of the base instincts. Bhagwan Swaminarayan brought his abode, Akshar, on earth with him to make us pure and virtuous. If one attains the virtues of Gunatitanand Swami then God accepts our services. The Sadhu is like a mother, who cleans her child of all base instincts and places him in the lap of God. The murti consecrated here today will forgive all of their faults and fulfil your wishes. By believing God to be the all-doer and doing bhakti, he will fulfil your wishes and grant you peace and happiness. By the grace of Maharaj whoever comes here for darshan and performs abhishek will have his wishes fulfiled. This applies not only to the people of Amdavad but Maharaj will also liberate and fulfil the wishes of people from India and abroad.” Swamishri performed the first abhishek of the seated panchdhatu murti of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Over 9,000 devotees witnessed the pratishtha rituals and heard Swamishri’s blessings through a closed circuit TV and large screen arrangement in the huge assembly hall. After darshan of the abhishek murti devotees took mahaprasad.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
13 June 2006, Amdavad
Two youths and three female devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Gandhinagar (25km).
25 June 2006, Amdavad
Eight male devotees and seven female devotees pilgrimaged 40 km by foot from Nardipur,

20 kishores and six female devotees from Dahegam (35km), six male devotees and six female devotees from Sanand (36km), two devotees from Bhuvaldi (20km), 10 devotees from Kalol (45km), 70 yuvaks and 7 female devotees from Gandhinagar (36km), 75 devotees from Bopal (18km), 19 devotees from Palsana (Kalol), 11 devotees from the suburb of Krushnanagar and Ghatlodiya,
Parth Y. Patel, Vrundan H. Patel, Umang Y. Mistry and Milap P. Thakkar, aged 12-15 years performed a dandvat yatra from the suburb of Isanpur. 11 devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Siddhpur.

Eighty-six devotees observed a waterless fast.
Two volunteers of the children’s wing cycled from Amdavad

Diptiben Surani of Narayanagar suburb observed an 86-hour waterless fast. Six girls performed a waterless fast and female volunteers of a children’s forum pilgrimaged by foot to the mandir in Shahibaug.

w: After his meal, when the reading of the Sampradaya's scriptures came up, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "By reading the life stories of the Gunatit gurus, we learn how they lived their lives and gain knowledge as well. If we leave those and keep reading other things, the foundation does not become firm. First make our principles firm, and then go on to study other things."

After the meal, when talk turned to reading the scriptures of the Sampraday, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "By reading the life stories of the Gunatit gurus we learn how they lived their lives, and at the same time we also gain knowledge. If we leave them aside and keep reading other things, the foundation does not become firm. First make our own principles firm, and then go on to study other things."

After the meal, when the talk turned to reading the scriptures of the Sampraday, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "By reading the biographies of the Gunatit gurus, we learn how they lived their lives, and along with that we also gain knowledge. If we leave them and keep reading other things, the foundation does not become firm. First make our principles firm, and then go on to study other things."

After the meal, as reading of the sampraday's scriptures came up, Swamishri said, "Reading the life stories of the Gunatit gurus teaches us how they lived, and gives knowledge at the same time. If we leave them aside and keep reading other things, the foundation does not become firm. First make our own principles firm, and then study other things."

Due to delayed monsoon rains Swamishri had instructed that prayers in the form of dhun be sung before Thakorji in the mandir and thereafter in his morning puja. After his puja was over at 8.30 am Swamishri told the sadhus to continue singing the dhun. Till 9.00 am Swamishri and all the devotees prayed for rains. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Today is ekadashi. Bhagwan Vaman came to King Bali and asked for three steps as charity. His guru warned him that the boy was God, and that he had come to trick him. But Bali replied what was wrong in being deceived by God. He gave his all. True devotees had sacrificed everything for God. Narsinh Mehta, Dada Khachar, Parvatbhai and others gave everything to God and in return they were blessed with eternal happiness.” Swamishri also blessed that the rains will arrive and fill all the natural reservoirs, rivers and dams.

Rajat Sharma, the well known anchor of the famous TV channel who brought fame to India TV through 'Aapki Adalat', had come for darshan. He is the owner of India TV. He has been deeply moved since he once came, unplanned, for darshan of Akshardham here.

After having Pramukh Swami Maharaj's darshan, he said, "I have wanted to meet you for a long time. I had come here earlier to see Akshardham. It is very good, vast and educative. Every person should come here. Everyone should know what our culture is.

After seeing this mandir, my son said to me, 'Papa! Instead of spending so much on a mandir, wouldn't it have been good to build a hospital and a school?' Then I said, 'If even ten people coming to a mandir like Akshardham are inspired to build hospitals and schools, then understand that the work of this mandir is done. There should be institutions like this that give people such inspiration.' The cleanliness that is here should be in every place and every mandir. My only complaint is that there are so many big mandirs in our country, but there is no cleanliness! Akshardham is the one place where there is cleanliness. Coming here, a spiritual feeling truly arises from within. Please run a campaign so that all the mandirs of the country are cleaned, and you yourself take charge of cleaning all the mandirs of the country."

Swamishri said, "From religious places we get inspiration to do something good. Whether it is a mandir, a scripture or a sadhu, we get such inspiration from them. Whoever gets inspiration will do good work with integrity for the country and for society. If there are ethics and integrity, good work certainly happens, and if there are no ethics, people get involved in other activities. That is why all these are needed."

Rajat Sharma said, "Seeing the people here who have obtained high degrees and left their careers to engage in this work, I have been inspired. If I can do anything through India TV to take your work forward, please let us know."
Swamishri was very pleased with his feeling and blessed him.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj met Bhupinder Hooda, the Chief Minister of Haryana. He had studied in Gujarat in his childhood. Blessing him, Swamishri said, "My blessings that there is happiness and peace in the country, the people are happy, there is good development and everyone's thoughts remain good."
Bhupinder Hooda said, "You have built a very good place. Coming here, one finds peace and tranquillity."

A spiritual seeker phoned. He had now recovered from a hard to cure illness. He said, "When the illness came, you had blessed me, 'The bacteria will go and will not come back.' At that time I laughed. I doubted you, thinking how could such a thing happen? But that is exactly what happened. So please forgive me."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "God has been compassionate. It is Yogi Bapa's blessing. As human beings we have doubts, but God and the Sant have compassion. Since they have accepted you as their own, they take care of you and will continue to do so."

Rajat Sharma, the famous TV anchor who made India TV well known through "Aap Ki Adalat", came for darshan. He is the owner of India TV. After once coming to Akshardham here quite by chance, he has been deeply moved.

After having Pramukh Swami Maharaj's darshan, he said, "I have wanted to meet you for a long time. Earlier I came here to see Akshardham. It is very good, vast and educative. Every person should come here. Everyone should know what our culture is.

After seeing this mandir, my son said to me, 'Papa! Instead of spending so much on a mandir, wouldn't it have been good to build a hospital and a school?' Then I said, 'If even ten people who come to a mandir like Akshardham are inspired to build hospitals and schools, understand that this mandir has done its work. There should be institutions like this that give people such inspiration.' The cleanliness here should be there everywhere, in every mandir. My only complaint is that there are so many big temples in our country, but there is no cleanliness! Akshardham is the one place where there is cleanliness. Coming here, a spiritual feeling truly rises from within. Please run a campaign so that all the temples of the country are cleaned, and you yourself take charge of the work of cleaning all the temples of the country."

Swamishri said, "From places of religion we get inspiration to do something good. Whether it is a mandir, a scripture or a sant, we get such inspiration from them. One who gets inspiration will do good work honestly for the country and for society. If there are morals, rules and honesty, good work is certainly done, and if there are no morals and rules, people get caught up in other activities. That is why all these are needed."

Rajat Sharma said, "Seeing those who have earned high degrees and left their careers to engage in this work here, I have been inspired. If I can do anything through India TV to take your work forward, please tell us."
Swamishri was very pleased with his feelings and blessed him.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj met Bhupendra Hooda, the Chief Minister of Haryana. He had studied in Gujarat as a child. Blessing him, Swamishri said, "My blessings are that there is happiness and peace in the country, the people are happy, there is good development and everyone's thoughts remain good."
Bhupendra Hooda said, "You have created a very good place. Coming here, one finds peace and calm."

A seeker phoned. He had now recovered from a hard to cure illness. He said, "When I fell ill, you had blessed me, 'The bacteria will go away and will not come back.' At that time I laughed. I doubted you, how can such a thing happen? But it happened just so. So please forgive me."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Bhagwan has had mercy. It is Yogi Bapa's blessing. As humans we may doubt, but Bhagwan and the Sant have compassion. Since they have accepted you as their own, they take care of you and will take care of you."
Today Mahant Swami Maharaj began walking on a treadmill in the dining room itself, and the Yogi Vani class too...
In it came a talk in which Yogi Bapa said, "And how powerful he is. Through the power of Bhagwan, he himself gives the souls of the universe the power to walk, to work and so on."
From this, Swamishri emphasised the words "through the power of Bhagwan." The great sadhu always keeps Bhagwan foremost.
Another talk came, in which Yogi Bapa said, "If one fasts once at the word of Shastriji Maharaj, one gets the fruit of a year long austerity."
The sadhus asked, "Swami! Tomorrow itself there is the ekadashi fast by Shastriji Maharaj's command, so by keeping that fast, will everyone get the fruit of fasting for 12 months?"
Swamishri said, "They will get ten million times as much." Then he said, "In 'Purushottam Bolya Prite,' Maharaj has said it: page 27 or page 35."

The sadhus were amazed that Swamishri remembered the talk along with the page numbers! Immediately the book "Purushottam Bolya Prite" was brought. Both pages were opened. On both of them Maharaj has spoken wonderfully of the glory of ekadashi.

Today in the evening assembly, after finishing his blessings, Mahant Swami Maharaj called Atmaswarupdas Swami to him and had an announcement made: "Swamishri has asked us to say that you should not keep too many nadachhadis (sacred threads on the wrist). Keep one that is sanctified, and keep the rest in a box."
What a guru we have! He cares even about the sacred threads on our wrists.
After the chesta today, Gnanpriyadas Swami said to Mahant Swami Maharaj, "You are very strong in mind."
Swamishri said, "There is no mind at all. Only thoughts of Bhagwan keep coming."
This one sentence alone is enough to prove him different from the whole of humanity.
